verdict.rationale: The documented deployment is hybrid: the scanner, S3 storage, and all AI inference run in your own AWS account, while Gecko still hosts the dashboard, database, and scan orchestration. That means the full core product is not self-hosted. A higher pricing tier lists "On-prem / self-hosted / private cloud", and a releases endpoint returns digest-pinned image refs, but no docs describe a fully self-hosted install. Missing for 10: documented fully self-hosted deployment (including dashboard, DB and orchestration), install/operations docs for on-prem, availability outside an enterprise tier, independent hands-on corroboration.
